abstract: The expression of HLA class I antigens in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) was studied by the immunoperoxidase technique. In the normal testicle, the interstitial cells of Leydig as well as most of the germ cells were significantly stained. In typical seminoma, 75% of the tumor cells in stage I and 30% in stage II were stained. In embryonal cell carcinoma, 25% of the cases in stage I and less than 10% of those in stage II were stained. Mature teratoma was stained in most of the cases, whereas in malignant teratoma only 35% of the cases showed some staining of the tumor cells. In mixed tumors each component displayed its characteristic staining pattern. The expression of class I antigens on tumor cells is required for immune recognition and lysis of the tumor by cytotoxic T-cells. The reduced expression of class I antigens that was related to histologic characteristics and stage suggests that some testicular tumors may escape immune surveillance and become biologically more aggressive.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるHLAクラスI抗原の発現を免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で検討した。正常精巣では、ライディッヒ細胞と大半の胚細胞が有意に染色された。典型的なセミノーマでは、病期Iの腫瘍細胞の75%、病期IIの30%が染色された。胎児性癌では、病期Iの25%、病期IIの10%未満で染色された。成熟奇形腫は大半の症例で染色されたが、悪性奇形腫では腫瘍細胞の35%のみに何らかの染色が認められた。混合型腫瘍では、各成分が特徴的な染色パターンを示した。腫瘍細胞におけるクラスI抗原の発現は、細胞傷害性T細胞による腫瘍の免疫認識と溶解に必要である。組織学的特徴および病期に関連したクラスI抗原の発現低下は、一部の精巣腫瘍が免疫監視を逃れ、生物学的により悪性度の高いものとなる可能性を示唆する。
